Subject: Re: AtlasEdge onboarding - PO allocation mismatch (lines dropped)

Thanks Naomi — quick update after checking the issuance logs.

What we found:
- The PO issuance service received the full payload (all SKUs) from the onboarding pipeline.
- During the final normalization step a rule deduplicated an internal SKU code that matched an existing tokenized item; SKU A-37 was filtered because its vendor_code matched a deprecated internal mapping (edge_case dedupe rule). That pruned two lines (A-37 and C-09) because C-09 was a child-line linked to A-37 in our lineage table.

Proposed remediation (fast path):
1) Issue a provisional PO (PO-43321-PROV) that contains the missing lines only so AtlasEdge can submit to their AP and keep the cutover schedule.
2) Patch the normalization rule to bypass dedupe for onboarding payloads where vendor_onboarding_form.pdf is present and vendor-confirmation=true (we'll roll this change behind a short canary).
3) Re-issue a canonical PO (PO-43321) after patch; deprecate the provisional PO once the canonical one is accepted.

Spend cap recommendation:
- We'll split the canonical order into two buckets to respect AtlasEdge internal limits: PO-43321-A (up to $45,000) and PO-43321-B (remaining ~ $13,200). The provisional PO will only include the missing lines and a temporary cap of $15,000 so they can get through AP.

I've attached a provisional_po_43321.pdf and a lineitem_fix_v2.csv with the exact line mapping for the provisional PO. Monica
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments:

Jill — thanks for the patience. Quick summary and next steps below.

Summary:
- Root cause: internal dedupe rule removed SKU A-37 and its dependent SKU C-09 during normalization. This happened only for onboarding payloads that matched a legacy vendor_code pattern.
- Immediate action: procurement issued a provisional PO (PO-43321-PROV) that contains the two missing lines and a temporary $15,000 cap so your AP can accept the invoice.
- Follow-up: we will patch the normalization rule, canary it against recent onboarding traffic, and then re-issue the canonical PO split into two purchase identifiers to respect your approval thresholds (PO-43321-A $45,000 / PO-43321-B $13,200).

What I attached for you: lineitem_fix_v2.csv that lists the two corrected line entries and provisional_po_43321.pdf (provisional PO). Please confirm when your AP accepts PO-43321-PROV and we will proceed with the canonical split.

If you'd prefer, we can also route the canonical split to a single AP ticket and tag the second PO for staged acceptance — happy to follow whichever internal process AtlasEdge needs.

Thanks again — Naomi
